the third point should be enough, as we copy data from backup to main location here.

This is a draft TODO to keep note of scenarios we may need to handle. 

We have to take care of the directory hierarchy while copying the data from backup to primary location.
For example, backup path may have `/var/lib/phosphor-data-sync/bmc_data_bkp/var/lib/phosphor-inventory-manager/xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/chassis/motherboard/pcieslot1` the corresponding primary(main) PIM path is `/var/lib/phosphor-inventory-manager/xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/chassis/motherboard/pcieslot1`.

Ideally, this should be handled by logic similar to `cp /var/lib/phosphor-data-sync/bmc_data_bkp/var/lib/phosphor-inventory-manager* /var/lib/phosphor-inventory-manager/*`, but we need to discuss and finalize this design.

2. Incase, it fails,  I would argue we should re-trying `restorePimBackupData()` would be a less expensive approach than triggering FRUs VPD collection.
